text:
jess_ae: Helios TeleMed asked for an APAC pilot support: egress allowlist + temporary rate-window bump for 72 hours to validate real-time transcript volume. Renewal touchpoint in ~30d; flagged as medium risk if pilot UX suffers. Can infra expedite?
maria_cs: Need exact CIDRs, target regions, and which endpoints (api/embeddings/stream). Also whether test traffic will hit prod.
jess_ae: They provided CIDRs and said prod traffic will be used for fidelity. Endpoints: /v1/generate (streaming) and /v1/embeddings. Want 2x rate window from 2024-07-12T00:00Z for 72h.
ryan_infra: I can implement. Please route the CIDRs to me and confirm a CS owner for sign-off. I'll check Dedicated pool headroom in ap-southeast-1 + ap-northeast-1.
infra_bot: Created incident ticket INC-2150: "Helios APAC pilot - allowlist + temporary RL" assigned ryan_infra; initial triage ETA 90m.
maria_cs: I'll confirm start/end and whether they have a non-prod fallback. Also will capture metrics Helios wants us to report (latency percentiles, error rate, token costs).
oliver_support: Suggest we put an alert at 75% of the bumped cap and a rollback automation if sustained >90% for 10m, based on Meridian incident.
sophia_renewals: Noted for renewal playbook. If pilot shows increased errors or costs, renewal likelihood drops. AE/CS should schedule a 1:1 post-pilot review.
ryan_infra: CIDRs received: 203.57.120.0/22, 103.14.200.0/24, 43.230.64.0/18. Plan: allowlist on edge nodes in ap-southeast-1 + ap-northeast-1, then apply RL multiplier x2 for 72h. Will stage changes in staging first.
ryan_infra: Command I'll run (staging): ```sh
redwood infra allowlist add --cidr 203.57.120.0/22 --regions ap-southeast-1,ap-northeast-1 --note "Helios pilot"
redwood rl set --customer helios-telemed --factor 2 --duration 72h --notify cs@redwood
```
maria_cs: Please include an internal note with pilot start/end, expected QPS, and the renewal flag. I'll prepare an email template to collect Helios feedback (latency, hallucinations, integration pain).
oliver_support: Set alert rule: if tokens/sec > 0.8 * bumped_cap for 15m -> send to #oncall and trigger auto-rollback. Also log a metric snapshot every 5m.
ryan_infra: Change deployed to staging (ap-southeast-1). Prod rollout scheduled for 2024-07-12T00:00Z after final CS confirmation. I'll leave a rollback playbook in the ticket.
maria_cs: Confirmed with Helios; prod rollout approved. I'll update renewal notes and add post-pilot feedback checklist to the account. Thanks all :rocket:
